name: ai-gen
title: OpenAI Generator
description: AI generation using OpenAI's GPT-3 and DALL·E AI models
author: josephschmitt

commands.name: createImage
commands.title: Create Image
commands.subtitle: DALL·E Image Generation
commands.description: Generate images using OpenAI's DALL·E 2, an AI system that can create realistic images and art from a description in natural language

commands.name: createImageVariation
commands.title: Create Image Variation
commands.subtitle: DALL·E Existing Image Variation
commands.description: Generate a variation of an existing image using OpenAI's DALL·E 2

commands.name: createImageEdit
commands.title: Create Image Edit
commands.subtitle: DALL·E Existing Image Edit
commands.description: Generate an edited or extended image given an original image and a prompt using OpenAI's DALL·E 2

commands.name: completeText
commands.title: Complete Text
commands.subtitle: GPT-3 Text Completion
commands.description: Input some text as a prompt, and generate a text completion that attempts to match whatever context or pattern you gave it

commands.name: generate-image
commands.title: Generate or Edit Image
commands.subtitle: OpenAI-Compatible Provider
commands.description: Generate or edit an image with your own provider and model, then save it locally

commands.name: run-image-job
commands.title: Run Image Job
commands.description: Runs a submitted Generate or Edit Image request in the background

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: OpenAI API key for Create Image, Create Image Variation, Create Image Edit, and Complete Text. Custom-provider commands use a separate key.

preferences.name: enableDrafts
preferences.label: Enable drafts
preferences.title: Drafts
preferences.description: Any un-submitted requests will be stored as a draft and can be resumed from the main Raycast window

preferences.name: storeValue
preferences.label: Store prompt
preferences.title: Prompts
preferences.description: Store your most recently submitted prompt instead of starting from a blank slate when running the command next

preferences.name: imageApiBaseUrl
preferences.title: Image Provider Base URL
preferences.description: For Generate or Edit Image and AI tools only. Include the version path, e.g. https://your-provider.example/v1.

preferences.name: imageApiKey
preferences.title: Image Provider API Key
preferences.description: Separate key for Generate or Edit Image and AI tools. The existing OpenAI key is never used for this provider.

preferences.name: imageOutputDirectory
preferences.title: Save Provider Images To
preferences.description: For Generate or Edit Image and AI tools. Defaults to ~/Pictures/OpenAI Generator/.

tools.name: generate-image
tools.title: Generate Image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using the user's configured image API. Returns a local image file and Markdown preview.

tools.name: edit-image
tools.title: Edit Image
tools.description: Edit a local PNG, JPEG, or WebP image using a prompt. Requires an absolute local image path supplied by the user or returned by a previous image tool.

ai.instructions: Use generate-image for new images and edit-image for changes to an existing image. Preserve the user's prompt language and intent. Use a previous tool result's absolute path for follow-up edits. Never invent local file paths. If an attachment has no accessible local path, ask the user to save it and supply the path or use the Generate or Edit Image command. Display the returned markdown image and include a link to the saved file. Never claim success without a successful tool result. Do not retry failed generation automatically, as it may incur charges.
